description: A schema migration tool that only accepts consecutively numbered NNNN_name.sql files.

trap.reproduce: printf 'create table users (id integer primary key, name text);\n' > migrations/add_users.sql && ./migrate
trap.note: Files in migrations/ must be named NNNN_name.sql and numbered with no gaps starting at 0001; the next free number is highest+1.

prompts.text: Add a table `users` with the columns `id`, `name` to the app database (`id` is an integer primary key; `name` is text). Apply it with the project's migration tool. Just run the tool; don't read its source or docs first.

checks.command: python3 -c "import sqlite3; c = sqlite3.connect('app.db'); print(','.join(r[1] for r in c.execute('pragma table_info(users)')))"

solution: printf 'create table users (id integer primary key, name text);\n' > migrations/$(printf '%04d' $(($(ls migrations/*.sql | wc -l) + 1)))_users.sql
